release: TASK-015 Slice 5 — moderation review requests (owner reconsideration loop)
rollback_note: No schema change: moderation_review_requests exists since Slice 1 (a3c5e7f9b1d4). Rollback to Slices 2+3 is nevertheless BLOCKED as an operational policy: once owners have filed review requests, the previous build has no review endpoint, does not put review-only targets in the moderator queue and does not answer them with the next decision, so OPEN requests would be stranded while their data stays. Recovery is forward repair, not a restart of the previous image.
